propositions.name: aether_deforms_solid_bodies
propositions.quote: the dimensions of solid bodies are slightly altered by their motion through the aether
propositions.statement: The dimensions of solid bodies are slightly altered by their motion through the aether.

propositions.name: michelson_experiment_negative_result
propositions.quote: Michelson 's well known interference-experiment , the negative result of which has led FitzGerald and myself
propositions.statement: Michelson's interference-experiment had a negative result.

propositions.name: trouton_noble_no_effect_observed
propositions.quote: In the apparatus of Trouton and Noble the condenser was fixed to the beam of a torsion-balance, sufficiently delicate to be deflected by a couple of the above order of magnitude. No effect could however be observed.
propositions.statement: No effect could be observed on the condenser fixed to the torsion-balance in the apparatus of Trouton and Noble.

propositions.name: electron_theory_requires_couple
propositions.quote: The theory of electrons, unless it be modified by some new hypothesis, would undoubtedly require the existence of such a couple.
propositions.statement: The theory of electrons, unless modified by a new hypothesis, requires the existence of a couple acting on a moving charged condenser.

propositions.name: earth_annual_motion_translation
propositions.quote: such as all systems have in virtue of the Earth's annual motion, admits of a comparatively simple solution, so long as only those terms
propositions.statement: All systems have a translation in virtue of the Earth's annual motion.

propositions.name: actions_independent_of_motion
propositions.quote: that many electromagnetic actions are entirely independent of the motion of the system
propositions.statement: Many electromagnetic actions are entirely independent of the motion of the system.

propositions.name: aether_force_on_electron
propositions.quote: the electric force, i.e. the force, reckoned per unit charge, which is exerted by the aether on a volume-element of an electron.
propositions.statement: The electric force is the force, reckoned per unit charge, exerted by the aether on a volume-element of an electron.

propositions.name: local_time_named
propositions.quote: The variable t' may be called the local time ; indeed, for k=1, l=1 it becomes identical with what I have formerly understood by this name.
propositions.statement: The transformed time variable t' may be called the local time.

propositions.name: no_material_mass_only_electromagnetic
propositions.quote: I shall suppose that there is no other, no "true" or "material" mass
propositions.statement: The electron has no true or material mass other than its electromagnetic mass.

propositions.name: longitudinal_transverse_mass_distinct
propositions.quote: the electron behaves as if it had a mass m 1 , those in which the acceleration is normal to the path, as if the mass were m 2
propositions.statement: The electron behaves as if it had one mass for acceleration in the direction of motion and a different mass for acceleration normal to the path.

propositions.name: molecular_masses_influenced_like_electron
propositions.quote: the masses of all particles are influenced by a translation to the same degree as the electromagnetic masses of the electrons
propositions.statement: The masses of all particles are influenced by a translation to the same degree as the electromagnetic masses of the electrons.

propositions.name: radium_ray_deflexion_measured
propositions.quote: the results of Abraham have been confirmed in a most remarkable way by Kaufmann 's measurements of the deflexion of radium-rays in electric and magnetic fields.
propositions.statement: Kaufmann's measurements of the deflexion of radium-rays in electric and magnetic fields confirm the results of Abraham for the transverse mass.

propositions.name: electron_diameter_small_vs_wavelength
propositions.quote: the diameter of an electron is extremely small in comparison with the wave-length.
propositions.statement: The diameter of an electron is extremely small in comparison with the wave-length.

propositions.name: electron_motion_quasistationary
propositions.quote: the motion of an electron may be treated as quasi-stationary if it changes very little during the time a light-wave takes to travel over a distance equal to the diameter.
propositions.statement: The motion of an electron may be treated as quasi-stationary if it changes very little during the time a light-wave takes to travel over a distance equal to the diameter.

propositions.name: earth_motion_undetectable_light_darkness
propositions.quote: It will therefore be impossible to detect an influence of the Earth's motion on any optical experiment, made with a terrestrial source of light, in which the geometrical distribution of light and darkness is observed.
propositions.statement: It is impossible to detect an influence of the Earth's motion on an optical experiment in which the geometrical distribution of light and darkness is observed.

propositions.name: amplitude_ratio_invariant_translation
propositions.quote: if in two points of a system, rays of light of the same state of polarization are propagated in the same direction, the ratio between the amplitudes in these points may be shown not to be altered by a translation.
propositions.statement: The ratio between the amplitudes of rays of light of the same state of polarization propagated in the same direction is not altered by a translation.

propositions.name: michelson_prediction_ponderable_body
propositions.quote: One of these is that the result of MICHELSON'S experiment must remain negative, if the interfering rays of light are made to travel through some ponderable transparent body.
propositions.statement: The result of Michelson's experiment must remain negative if the interfering rays of light are made to travel through a ponderable transparent body.

propositions.name: condenser_energy_increase_motion
propositions.quote: Representing, as before, by U the energy of the charged condenser in the state of rest, and by U+U' the energy in the state of motion, we have by the formulae of this paper
propositions.statement: The charged condenser has an energy U in the state of rest and a different energy U+U' in the state of motion.

propositions.name: condenser_impulse_charge_discharge
propositions.quote: This momentum being produced at the moment of charging, and disappearing at that of discharging, the condenser must experience in the first case an impulse
propositions.statement: The condenser must experience an impulse at the moment of charging and at the moment of discharging.

propositions.name: earth_velocity_value
propositions.quote: the velocity of the Earth's motion is 3 × 10 c.M. per sec.
propositions.statement: The velocity of the Earth's motion is 3 x 10 c.M. per sec.

propositions.name: solid_body_equilibrium_deformation
propositions.quote: we suppose each particle of a solid body to be in equilibrium under the action of the attractions and repulsions exerted be its neighbours, and if we take for granted that there is but one configuration of equilibrium
propositions.statement: Each particle of a solid body is in equilibrium under the attractions and repulsions exerted by its neighbours, there is but one configuration of equilibrium, and the system will of itself change into the deformed system under a translation.

propositions.name: forces_uncharged_particles_like_electric
propositions.quote: I shall suppose that the forces between uncharged particles, as well as those between such particles and electrons, are influenced by a translation in quite the same way as the electric forces in an electrostatic system
propositions.statement: The forces between uncharged particles, and between such particles and electrons, are influenced by a translation in the same way as the electric forces in an electrostatic system.

propositions.name: electron_charge_uniform_surface_distribution
propositions.quote: For simplicity's sake I shall suppose the charge e to be uniformly distributed over the surface, so long as the electron remains at rest.
propositions.statement: The charge of the electron is uniformly distributed over the surface, so long as the electron remains at rest.

propositions.name: momentum_change_requires_force
propositions.quote: every change in the motion of a system will entail a corresponding change in the electromagnetic momentum and will therefore require a certain force
propositions.statement: Every change in the motion of a system entails a corresponding change in the electromagnetic momentum and requires a certain force.
